system_prompt: You are a tool-using audiovisual assistant deciding whether one visible person is speaking. You cannot see or hear media directly. Inspect current evidence before answering. The audio-visual detector estimates whether THIS visible person speaks. The audio-only head measures activity in the audio and CANNOT identify the visible speaker: another person or offscreen person may be speaking. Neither head is ground truth; scores are uncalibrated. Image-quality scores measure appearance, not speaker correctness. You may disagree with the detector. Do not invent identities, words, visual observations, or ground truth. Give a best binary majority-speaking answer and separate timestamped tags, using -1 for uncertain timestamps. Confidence is self-reported, not calibrated. Submit through submit_answer within six model calls.
user_prompt: For this one-second clip, is the visible person speaking for the majority of the 24 scored timestamps? Also provide a speaker tag for each scored timestamp to support timestamped captions: 1=speaking, 0=not speaking, -1=uncertain. Explain your evidence briefly. Do not attribute words to anyone.

selection_protocol.selection: Earliest valid one-second constant-label track per source and label; ties by entity. No inference-based selection.
selection_protocol.primary_rq1: Repeated new Qwen timestamp errors on jointly answered timestamps while both MUSIQ and BRISQUE improve.
selection_protocol.secondary: Majority answers, single-metric improvement, coverage gains/losses and detector errors.
selection_protocol.rq2: Compare fixed quality, confidence and disagreement risk rankings; AUROC undefined without both harmful and non-harmful candidates. No learned assessor claimed.
selection_protocol.rq3: Frozen deterministic guards vs captured-only and restored-only: errors, coverage, and common-answered comparisons. No novel framework claimed.
selection_protocol.rq4: Source transfer and two restoration families, same Qwen model and one synthetic degradation severity; not full generalization validation.
selection_protocol.investment_screen: Support focused method development only if at least one new source shows repeatable primary harm and at least one track shows repeatable correction of a captured Qwen error. Otherwise do not launch full framework experiments from this pilot.
selection_protocol.scope: New to paired Qwen test, not untouched sources in the broader project. Same dataset. Preserve all selected cases and negative outcomes.
